newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PM congratulates Blair on UK poll victory.
newsitem.headline: Czech PM congratulates Blair on UK poll victory.

text.p: Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus congratulated new British Premier Tony Blair on his appointment and said he looked forward to maintaining close ties between the two countries.

"I believe your government will be successful and continue the extraordinarily good relations between our countries," Klaus, who heads a centre-right coalition, said in a letter to Blair released by his office on Friday.
